description: This PHP class 'MenuService' manages menu items, caching, and permissions for the OrangeHRM system, including methods for enabling, invalidating, and retrieving menu structures with caching and permission checks.

classes.name: MenuService
classes.description: Service class for managing menu items, caching, and permissions within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getMenuDao
methods.description: Returns the MenuDao instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getScreenPermissionService
methods.description: Returns the ScreenPermissionService instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: enableModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Enables menu items for a specific module and clears related cache.

methods.name: invalidateCachedMenuItems
methods.description: Clears cached menu items and related attributes.

methods.name: getDetailedSidePanelMenuItemsAlongWithCache
methods.description: Retrieves detailed side panel menu items, using cache if available.

methods.name: getTopMenuItemsAlongWithCache
methods.description: Retrieves top menu items for a given side panel menu item, using cache if available.

methods.name: generateCacheKeyForTopMenuItem
methods.description: Generates cache key for top menu items based on side panel menu item ID.

methods.name: getMenuItems
methods.description: Constructs and returns the menu structure based on current module, screen, and permissions.

methods.name: getMenuItemChainForMenuItem
methods.description: Builds a chain of parent menu items for a given menu item.

methods.name: isActiveSidePanelMenuItem
methods.description: Determines if a side panel menu item is active based on current module and screen.

methods.name: isActiveTopMenuItem
methods.description: Determines if a top menu item is active based on current module and screen.

methods.name: normalizeMenuItem
methods.description: Normalizes a DetailedMenuItem into an array with URL, name, and active status.

methods.name: normalizeTopMenuItem
methods.description: Normalizes a DetailedMenuItem into a top menu structure, including children.
